text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr decided to run in the 
long-distance Arima Kinen. Her objective: 
naturally—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having made a comeback after repeated 
injuries... all to run alongside Tokai 
Teio. Tokai Teio says—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if I can't run like I used to, I'll 
still win. Because I'm... going to surpass 
the "Emperor." I am the invincible "Teio" 
who makes miracles happen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr felt that she was stronger 
now than she had ever been before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"That is why she would become the swiftest 
wind, capable of swallowing even that 
miracle— The battle both had been waiting 
for was finally about to begin."
